result.topic_en: Formula-only calculations for the rotating fluid ellipsoid: a change of variables to $\beta,\alpha$ with $b=(\beta^2-\alpha^2)^{-1/6}$, first-order PDEs for auxiliary functions $\psi,\varphi$, and a series ansatz $y=f(\beta)+\alpha^2 f''(\beta)/16+\dots$ with $f(\beta)=\log(\beta/4)$ and the resulting coefficient computations.
result.transcription:
$\frac{4\tau^2}{(b-a)^2} = -\frac{1}{b}\frac{\partial \mathcal{H}}{\partial m} + \frac{1}{a}\frac{\partial \mathcal{H}}{\partial n}$ $\quad (b-a)^3+(b+a)^3 = [-\ldots-]$
$\frac{\tau'^2}{(b+a)^2} = -\frac{1}{b}\frac{\partial \mathcal{H}}{\partial m} - \frac{1}{a}\frac{\partial \mathcal{H}}{\partial n}$

$ab(\tau^2+\tau'^2) = [-ab-] - ab(b^2+3a^2)\frac{\partial \mathcal{H}}{\partial m} - ab(3b^2+a^2)\frac{\partial \mathcal{H}}{\partial n}$ $\quad \mathcal{H} = \frac{1}{b} y$
$ab(\tau^2-\tau'^2) = -a^2(3b^2+a^2)\frac{\partial \mathcal{H}}{\partial m} - b^2(b^2+3a^2)\frac{\partial \mathcal{H}}{\partial n}$ $\quad \frac{\partial \mathcal{H}}{\partial m} = \frac{1}{b}\left(\frac{\partial y}{\partial m} - y\right)$
$a^2 \alpha^2 b^2 = (\beta^2-\alpha^2) b^6 = \mathrm{const}$

$-(\tau^2+\tau'^2) = b\left(+(1+3(\beta+\alpha))\left(\frac{\partial y}{\partial m}-y\right) + (3+\beta+\alpha)\frac{\partial y}{\partial n}\right)$ $\quad \frac{\partial y}{\partial n} = \frac{\partial y}{\partial q}$
$-(\tau^2-\tau'^2) = \frac{b^2}{a}\left(+^{\beta+\alpha}(3+\beta+\alpha)\left(\frac{\partial y}{\partial m}-y\right) + [-\ldots-](1+3(\beta+\alpha))\frac{\partial y}{\partial n}\right)$ $\quad \frac{\partial y}{\partial m} = \frac{1}{2}\left(\frac{\partial y}{\partial p} + \frac{\partial y}{\partial q}\right)$
$b\left((1+3(\beta+\alpha))\left(\frac{\partial y}{\partial p}-2y\right) + (7+5(\beta+\alpha))\frac{\partial y}{\partial q}\right)$ $\quad -[-\ldots-](\beta^2-\alpha^2)^{-\frac{1}{6}}\psi$ $\quad b = (\beta^2-\alpha^2)^{-\frac{1}{6}}\,\mathrm{const.}$ $\quad a = b(\beta+\alpha)^{\frac{1}{2}}$
$\frac{b^2}{a}\left(^{\beta+\alpha}(3+\beta+\alpha)\left(\frac{\partial y}{\partial p}-2y\right) + (2+9(\beta+\alpha)+4(\beta+\alpha)^2)\frac{\partial y}{\partial q}\right) = (\beta+\alpha)^{-\frac{2}{3}}(\beta-\alpha)^{-\frac{1}{6}}\varphi$
$-4\beta+4\alpha+\beta+\alpha$
$-\frac{2}{3}\frac{1}{\beta+\alpha} + \frac{1}{6}\frac{1}{\beta-\alpha}$

$y = \frac{\partial y}{\partial p} [-+-] -3\left(\frac{\partial y}{\partial \alpha}\alpha + \frac{\partial y}{\partial \beta}\beta\right)$ $\quad y = f(\beta) + \alpha^2\frac{f''(\beta)}{16} + \frac{\alpha^4 f^{IV}(\beta)}{16\cdot 36}$
$\frac{\partial y}{\partial q} [-+-] \frac{\partial y}{\partial \alpha}\beta + \frac{\partial y}{\partial \beta}\alpha$
$(\beta^2-\alpha^2)\frac{\partial\psi}{\partial\alpha} + \frac{1}{3}\alpha\psi \quad (\beta^2-\alpha^2)\frac{\partial\psi}{\partial\beta} - \frac{1}{3}\beta\psi$
$(\beta^2-\alpha^2)\frac{\partial\varphi}{\partial\alpha} + \frac{5}{6}\alpha\varphi[?] \frac{1}{2}\beta\varphi \quad (\beta^2-\alpha^2)\frac{\partial\varphi}{\partial\beta} - \frac{5}{6}\beta\varphi + \frac{1}{2}\alpha\varphi$

$\frac{\partial y}{\partial p} - 2y = -2f(\beta) - 2\alpha^2\frac{f''(\beta)}{16} - 2\alpha^4\frac{f^{IV}(\beta)}{16\cdot 36}$
$\qquad -6\alpha^2\frac{f''(\beta)}{16} - 12\alpha^4\frac{f^{IV}(\beta)}{16\cdot 36}$
$\qquad -3f'(\beta)\beta - 3\frac{f'''(\beta)}{16}\beta - 3\frac{f^{V}(\beta)}{16\cdot 36}\beta$
$(\beta+\alpha)\left(\frac{\partial\psi}{\partial\alpha}+\frac{\partial\psi}{\partial\beta}\right) - \frac{1}{3}\psi \quad (\beta-\alpha)\left(\frac{\partial\psi}{\partial\alpha}-\frac{\partial\psi}{\partial\beta}\right) + \frac{1}{3}\psi$
$(\beta+\alpha)\left(\frac{\partial\varphi}{\partial\alpha}+\frac{\partial\varphi}{\partial\beta}\right) - \frac{4}{3}\varphi \quad (\beta-\alpha)\left(\frac{\partial\varphi}{\partial\alpha}-\frac{\partial\varphi}{\partial\beta}\right) + \frac{1}{3}\varphi$
$\frac{1}{3}\varphi\psi + \frac{1}{3}\psi\left((\beta+\alpha)\left(\frac{\partial\psi}{\partial\alpha}+\frac{\partial\psi}{\partial\beta}\right) + 4(\beta-\alpha)\left(\frac{\partial\psi}{\partial\alpha}-\frac{\partial\psi}{\partial\beta}\right)\right)$

$\frac{\partial y}{\partial q} = \alpha\left(2\frac{f'''(\beta)}{16}\beta + 4\frac{\alpha^2 f^{V}(\beta)}{16\cdot 36}\right.$
$\qquad \left. + f'(\beta) + \alpha^2\frac{f'''(\beta)}{16}\right)$
$(-2\log\frac{\beta}{4}-3) + \alpha\, 7\cdot\frac{7}{8}\frac{1}{\beta} + \frac{1}{8}\frac{\alpha^2}{\beta^2} + 7\frac{\alpha^3}{\beta^3}\left([-1+-]\frac{1}{12} - \frac{1}{8} - \frac{1}{24}\frac{1}{12}\right)$
$+\frac{2}{3}\psi\left(-[-\ldots-]\beta\frac{\partial\varphi}{\partial\alpha} - \alpha\frac{\partial\varphi}{\partial\beta}\right) + (\beta^2-\alpha^2)\,2\left(\frac{\partial\psi}{\partial\beta}\frac{\partial\varphi}{\partial\alpha} - \frac{\partial\varphi}{\partial\beta}\frac{\partial\psi}{\partial\alpha}\right)$

$5\alpha\frac{\partial y}{\partial q} + (1+3\beta)\left(\frac{\partial y}{\partial p}-2y\right) + \left(\alpha\left(\frac{\partial y}{\partial p}-2y\right) + (7+5\beta)\frac{\partial y}{\partial q}\right)$

$\beta(3+\beta)\left(\frac{\partial y}{\partial p}-2y\right) \quad + (3+2\beta)\alpha\left(\frac{\partial y}{\partial p}-2y\right) + \frac{2+9\beta+\beta^2}{[-\ldots-]}\frac{\partial y}{\partial q}$
$+3\alpha(1+4\beta)\frac{\partial y}{\partial q} \qquad\qquad + 6\alpha^2$

$\psi \left\{ \begin{array}{l} \alpha\left(-2f\beta - 3f'\beta\beta + (7+5\beta)\left(f'(\beta) + \frac{1}{8}f'''(\beta)\beta\right)\right) \\ \alpha^3\left(-\frac{2}{?}f''(\beta) - \frac{3}{16}f'''(\beta)\beta + (7+5\beta)\left(\frac{f'''(\beta)}{16} + \frac{f^{V}(\beta)\beta}{16\cdot 9}\right)\right) \\ +(1+3\beta)\left(-2f(\beta) - 3f'(\beta)\beta\right) \\ +\alpha^2\left(\left(-\frac{1}{2}f''(\beta) - \frac{3}{16}f'''(\beta)\beta\right)(1+3\beta) + 5\left(f'(\beta) + \frac{1}{8}f'''(\beta)\beta\right)\right) \end{array}\right.$

$\varphi \left\{ \begin{array}{l} \alpha\left(-2f(\beta) - 3f'(\beta)\beta + 3(1+\beta+2\beta^2)\left(f'(\beta) + \frac{1}{8}f'''(\beta)\beta\right)\right) \\ \alpha^3( \end{array}\right.$
$\beta\frac{\partial\psi}{\partial\alpha} + \alpha\frac{\partial\psi}{\partial\beta} \quad \alpha\frac{\partial\psi}{\partial\alpha} + \beta\frac{\partial\psi}{\partial\beta} - \frac{1}{3}\psi$
$\beta\frac{\partial\varphi}{\partial\alpha} + \alpha\frac{\partial\varphi}{\partial\beta} \quad \frac{1}{2}\varphi \quad \alpha\frac{\partial\varphi}{\partial\alpha} + \beta\frac{\partial\varphi}{\partial\beta} - \frac{5}{3}\varphi$

$\sqrt{1-\beta}\log\beta$
$\frac{1}{\beta}\sqrt{1-\beta} - \frac{1}{2}(1-\beta)^{-\frac{1}{2}}\log\beta$
$[-\ldots-]\log\beta$
$-\frac{1}{\beta^2} - \frac{1}{2}\frac{1}{\beta} - \frac{1}{4}(1-\beta)^{-\frac{3}{2}}\log\beta$

$(-2\log\frac{\beta}{4}-3) + \frac{1}{8}\frac{\alpha^2}{\beta^2}$
$\psi: -2\log\frac{\beta}{4} - 3 + \frac{49}{8}\frac{\alpha}{\beta} + \frac{1}{8}\frac{\alpha^2}{\beta^2}$

$f(\beta) = \log\frac{\beta}{4}$
$f'(\beta) = \frac{1}{\beta}$
$f''(\beta) = -\frac{1}{\beta^2}$
$f'''(\beta) = +\frac{2}{\beta^3}$
$f^{IV}(\beta) = -\frac{6}{\beta^4}$

$\varphi \left\{ \begin{array}{l} 2\left(\frac{7}{8}\frac{\alpha}{\beta} + \frac{\alpha^3}{\beta^3}\frac{1}{12}[-\ldots-]\right) \\ +3\beta(-2\log\frac{\beta}{4}-3) + \frac{1}{2}\frac{1}{\beta^2} - \frac{3}{8}\frac{1}{\beta^2} = +\frac{1}{8}\frac{1}{\beta^2} \end{array}\right.$
$-[-6-]\,\frac{14}{3}[?]$
$3\beta(-2\log\frac{\beta}{4}-5) + \frac{5}{3}\varphi$

$\alpha = [-\ldots-]\,\frac{12}{7}\beta^2(2\log\frac{\beta}{4}+3)$

$\frac{49}{8} + \frac{1}{4}\frac{\alpha}{\beta}$

$-\frac{7}{4}\frac{\alpha^2}{\beta^2} + \frac{7}{4} - \frac{1}{2}\varphi$

methods.what: Expressions for squared rotation quantities $\tau^2,\tau'^2$ via partial derivatives of a function $\mathcal{H}$ in $m,n$
Parametrization of axes by $\beta,\alpha$ with a conserved quantity
Series ansatz for $y$ in even powers of $\alpha$
Computation of $\partial y/\partial p - 2y$ from the series ansatz
Choice of logarithmic generating function and its derivatives
Approximate relation for $\alpha$ in terms of $\beta$
